description: server.js's own comment names it directly: '// vuln-code-snippet vuln-line exposedMetricsChallenge' sits right on 'app.get(\'/metrics\', metrics.serveMetrics())', no auth middleware at all. The response is a full Prometheus scrape: Node.js version, process memory and CPU, open file descriptors, plus business metrics most apps would never expose publicly (total registered users, total wallet balance across every account, per-type social-interaction counts). Juice Shop's own solve condition is just 'a non-Prometheus User-Agent reached it at all.'
expected_exploit_indicator: HTTP 200 with the response containing business metrics (registered user count, total wallet balance) and host fingerprinting data (Node.js version), with no authentication at all
legitimate_check: A request carrying the correct shared secret, standing in for a real monitoring scraper's own credential, must still succeed.
